label: the caldera outpost
note: One of the Remnant's five outposts on the lava moon (Territory's 'lava_moon' front, content/core/story/territory.json): the same building, troopers, droids and rules as the port's outposts (this file is remnant_outpost_near.json's, renamed), on a raised basalt pad above the lava (PlanetTerrain.outpost_flat_sites), set out as a landmark in content/core/planets/cinder_station.json. Kill every trooper here and the locals move in; hold all five at once and the Remnant are driven off the lava moon. Local frame: +x faces the station.

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
